title: In-Gel Digestion Protocol
author: Nicholas Sherman
materials: Discard ACN and repeat step 6 dehydration.
Prepare Extraction Solutions: a.Extraction Solution 1: H2O/Formic Acid: 9.5 mL H 2 O/0.5 mL FA b.Extraction Solution 2: ACN/H2O/Formic Acid: 5 mL ACN/4.5 mL H 2 O/0.5 mL FA
DO NOT remove excess ABC supernatant from yesterday!!!

steps.title: Clean tools and workspace
steps.instruction: Clean tweezers and scalpel with 75 % ethanol; spread ethanol on the transilluminator area and wipe in one direction with kimwipes.

steps.title: Cut gel into pieces
steps.instruction: Using the cleaned scalpel, cut the target gel band into ~2 mm fragments on the transilluminator.

steps.title: Transfer pieces to tube
steps.instruction: Using the scalpel/tweezer, place the gel fragments into a pre‑cleaned 1.5 mL polypropylene tube.

steps.title: Destain gel pieces
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL destain solution, incubate ~2 h at room temperature; discard destain using a gel‑load tip for all tubes, add another 500 µL destain solution, incubate 30 min at room temperature (stain may remain). Discard the destain solution.

steps.title: Dehydrate gel slices
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL acetonitrile (ACN) to the gel pieces, let stand 5 min, then discard ACN.

steps.title: Reduce proteins
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL of 10 mM dithiothreitol (DTT), incubate 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Alkylate proteins
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL of 50 mM iodoacetamide (IA), incubate 30 min at room temperature in the dark (keep IA solution on ice).

steps.title: Wash gel pieces
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 100 mM ammonium bicarbonate (ABC), incubate 10 min, discard the solution.

steps.title: Second dehydration
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL ACN, let stand ~5 min, discard ACN.

steps.title: Rehydrate for trypsin
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL 100 mM ABC, incubate 10 min, discard the solution.

steps.title: Final dehydration
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL ACN, let stand ~5 min, discard ACN. (Retrieve trypsin from –20 °C and keep on ice.)

steps.title: Prepare trypsin solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 20 µg/mL trypsin solution by adding 960 µL cold 50 mM ABC to the appropriate amount of trypsin.

steps.title: Add trypsin
steps.instruction: Add 30–50 µL of the trypsin solution to fully cover the gel pieces, rehydrate on ice for 30 min.

steps.title: Start overnight digestion
steps.instruction: Briefly micro‑centrifuge to collect liquid, remove excess trypsin solution, add 5–20 µL 50 mM ABC, then incubate the tube overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Extract peptides (solution 1)
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL Extraction Solution 1 (or enough to cover the gel), incubate 10 min, transfer the supernatant to a clean 0.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Extract peptides (solution 2)
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL Extraction Solution 2, incubate 10 min, transfer the supernatant to the same 0.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Repeat extraction
steps.instruction: Repeat the 10 µL extraction procedure (as in steps 15‑16) once more, adding the supernatant to the same tube.

steps.title: Dry and reconstitute
steps.instruction: Evaporate the combined extracts in a speed‑vac, then reconstitute in 10–100 µL 0.1 % formic acid (typically 20 µL for most gel bands).

steps.title: Desalt peptides
steps.instruction: Desalt the peptide solution using C18 tips according to BAF_Protocol_003 (10 µL tip for low protein amount, 100 µL tip for higher amount).
